{{Short description|Foliation of symplectic manifolds}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''Lagrangian foliation''' or '''polarization''' is a [[foliation]] of a [[symplectic manifold]], whose leaves are [[Lagrangian submanifold]]s. It is one of the steps involved in the [[geometric quantization]] of a square-integrable functions on a symplectic manifold.

==References==
* Kenji FUKAYA, [http://www.math.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~fukaya/C1.pdf ''Floer homology of Lagrangian Foliation and Noncommutative Mirror Symmetry''], (2000)
